cohort: The study included 380 patients aged 12 years or older, referred to a tertiary center for a bleeding tendency, diagnosed with either bleeding of unknown cause (BUC) or an established bleeding disorder (BD).
finding: Bleeding complications, including major bleeding during surgical procedures and major postpartum hemorrhage during deliveries, are frequent in patients with bleeding of unknown cause, regardless of pre- or perioperative hemostatic treatment.
mod_finding: The study reported on bleeding complications during 'deliveries' generally but did not provide specific findings related to different modes of birth.
